run_get_robots: run the enterprise_routes get_robots endpoint to return robots.txt blocking web crawlers
run_get_audit_logs: run the enterprise_routes get_audit_logs endpoint to retrieve paginated audit logs with filtering
run_get_audit_log_by_id: run the enterprise_routes get_audit_log_by_id endpoint to fetch a specific audit log entry
run_get_email_event_settings: run the enterprise_routes get_email_event_settings endpoint to retrieve email notification settings
run_update_email_event_settings: run the enterprise_routes update_email_event_settings endpoint to update email notification event toggles
